{"initialHeight":500,"placeholderMessages":["Drawing the airplane","Labelling the three axes"],"css":"body{margin:0;background:#1a1a2e;color:#f8fafc;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}.airplane-card{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:640px;margin:auto;padding:16px}h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px}p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:13px;color:#cbd5e1}canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 16px;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px}","html":"

3D axes · model airplane

Static oblique projection of three perpendicular axes

X · longitudinal · rollY · lateral · pitchZ · vertical · yaw
","jsFunctions":"","jsExpressions":["(()=>{const c=document.getElementById('airplane-axes');const x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle='#1a1a2e';x.fillRect(0,0,600,400);const polygon=(points)=>{x.beginPath();points.forEach(([a,b],i)=>i?x.lineTo(a,b):x.moveTo(a,b));x.closePath();x.fill();x.stroke();};x.fillStyle='#cbd5e1';x.strokeStyle='#f8fafc';x.lineWidth=2;polygon([[225,125],[305,210],[385,305],[280,235]]);polygon([[180,200],[215,235],[250,285],[192,252]]);polygon([[455,185],[315,210],[180,250],[205,265],[330,238]]);x.fillStyle='#64748b';polygon([[365,205],[397,199],[375,216],[346,222]]);const axis=(a,b,color,label,lx,ly)=>{x.strokeStyle=color;x.fillStyle=color;x.lineWidth=3;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(300,230);x.lineTo(a,b);x.stroke();const angle=Math.atan2(b-230,a-300);x.beginPath();x.moveTo(a,b);x.lineTo(a-12*Math.cos(angle-.45),b-12*Math.sin(angle-.45));x.lineTo(a-12*Math.cos(angle+.45),b-12*Math.sin(angle+.45));x.closePath();x.fill();x.font='bold 24px system-ui';x.fillText(label,lx,ly);};axis(495,180,'#ef4444','X / Roll',480,159);axis(420,340,'#60a5fa','Y / Pitch',433,346);axis(300,55,'#cbd5e1','Z / Yaw',312,61);x.fillStyle='#fff';x.beginPath();x.arc(300,230,5,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();})()"]}
